svg.title: Pandora Farm: configured v2 layout
svg.desc: North-up plan from LivestockFarm.json. Large western livestock pen, water tower north, barn east, garden north of barn, chicken run and farmhouse south. Terrain, paths and animal positions are illustrative.
svg.text: Configured v2 layout / E6 river meadow / North up
A small rain catcher at each trough.
Open field shelter at the centre.
Frontier timber with a gabled roof.
Feed, clones, wool and dung stores;
two fridges and a large battery.
Two solar panels on the north roof.
Four surround a heated scarecrow deck.
Four coops in their own fenced run.
Potato and corn beds beside the yard.
Building footprints and equipment centres follow the 394-entry configuration at farm yaw 0.
River edge, paths, rock outline and livestock placement are illustrative; icons are enlarged for readability.
Source: server/carbon/configs/LivestockFarm.json + docs/livestock-farm.md | World centre: X -1542.9, Z 1227.3
